title: Planetary faunal lineage roster
scope: Roster of major animal body-plan lineages for Project Hearthway's planet at silhouette-and-niche-theme level; usable within shared-setting ecology and adopted downstream story development.
claims: The planet's macroscopic animal life is organised across seven major body-plan lineages, with familiar ecological roles distributed across different lineages rather than copied from Earth clades.

Lineage I comprises six-limbed animals whose outer covering combines filaments and flexible scutes; branches may repurpose limb pairs, including wing-pair branches that produce four-legged winged forms.
Lineage II is the tower-necked four-limbed landscape-engineer lineage governed by the existing Lineage II records.
Lineage III comprises low-frame four-limbed generalists; branches may develop forelimb wings that produce two-legged, two-winged forms.

Lineage IV is a fully aquatic flexible-trunk fin-fan lineage; the mass-breeding migrant established by canon://world/shared-universe-001/ecology/basin-lake-mass-breeder-foundational-body-plan belongs to it.
Lineage V is a tri-radial hydrostatic lineage; the family-care migrant established by canon://world/shared-universe-001/ecology/basin-lake-family-care-migrant-foundational-body-plan belongs to it.
Lineage VI comprises small-bodied segmented animals with exoskeletons, including branches capable of small-scale flight.
Lineage VII comprises unsegmented soft-bodied animals.
Powered or gliding flight arose independently in more than one lineage; no single lineage monopolises aerial niches.
Every lineage includes abundant ordinary, unremarkable forms; no lineage exists only to supply spectacular creatures.
boundaries: Roman numerals and functional labels are author-facing shorthand, not in-world names, formal taxonomy, or cladistic claims; final lineage and species names remain protected unknowns.

The roster fixes qualitative silhouette and niche themes only; exact anatomy, covering microstructure, sizes, proportions, reproduction, physiology, senses, cognition, species counts, and branch structure remain open except where existing bounded records govern.

Filament-and-scute establishes no fur, feather, or reptile-scale homology; low-frame four-limbed establishes no mammal, reptile, or other Earth-clade homology; segmented exoskeletal establishes no insect or crustacean homology; unsegmented soft-bodied establishes no worm or mollusc homology.
Wing-capable branches are body-plan possibilities; no particular winged species, its size ceiling, flight performance, range, or presence anywhere is established.
Deep ancestry, divergence order, relatedness among lineages, hybrid impossibility, and extinct sibling lineages remain open.
Microscopic animal-grade life and rare minor or relict lineages below the framework's grain remain possible but require their own records.
No lineage is established as present, abundant, or absent at any particular location, including the initial basin, beyond what existing records already establish.

The bird-like fishing organisms, resident lake fauna, terrestrial shore hunters, and aquatic predators referenced by canon://world/shared-universe-001/ecology/basin-lake-spring-breeding-pulse are not assigned to lineages by this record.
No sapient people, returning non-human people, or the parked pack species is assigned to any lineage by this record.
No domesticate, livestock, pest, or other human-use relationship is established.
Earth life of any era and mythological creatures may inspire author-facing design; no living, extinct, or legendary Earth species is transplanted directly.

Mana use across lineages remains open except where existing records govern; no Mana organ, specialised ability, System progression, universal creature level, spawn mechanism, reward, Skill, trait payload, or Ancestry Development rule is established.
Food, energy, reproduction, disease, injury, mortality, and carrying capacity remain binding ecological constraints for every lineage.
story_implications: Creature encounters can be designed lineage-first from stable silhouette slots with Earth and mythic inspiration kept author-facing.
Mythic four-legs-plus-wings forms and familiar two-winged forms can both exist, in different lineages.
Ordinary small-bodied life from Lineages VI and VII can populate scenes without every organism being spectacular.
Every particular species, its local presence, and any encounter requires its own evidence and records.
system_implications: The roster describes ordinary planetary ecology under CAL0 WLD1.2D and WLD2.1A+D.
No System mechanic, creature progression rule, spawn source, reward, or specialised Mana ability is established.
research_questions: What deep divergence history produced the seven lineages, and in what order?
Which lineages inhabit the initial basin and wider region, in which niches, beyond existing records?
What covering, reproduction, sensory, and Mana patterns characterise each undeveloped lineage?
Which lineage holds the bird-like fishing organisms and the other referenced-but-unassigned basin fauna?
What size ceilings and performance envelopes bound each lineage's winged branches?
Which minor or relict lineages, if any, persist below the framework's grain?

author_approval.evidence: After the A/B/C roster options were presented with A recommended, the Author replied 'A' on 2026-08-17.
